title: Arrangements with regard to functioning of all the Subordinate Courts in the State of Gujarat
text:
KEY LINES:
Date: 06-04-2021
earlier circulars shall apply mutatis mutandis.

FULL TEXT:
# 1 #
HIGH COURT OF GUJARAT AT AHMEDABAD
CIRCULAR
Date: 06-04-2021
The Hon’ble the Chief Justice and other Hon’ble Judges of the
Standing Committee, after taking into consideration the
exponential surge in COVID-19 cases and the views of
stakeholders, have been pleased to make the following
arrangements with regard to functioning of all the Subordinate
Courts in the State of Gujarat, in supersession of earlier
circulars:
1. For the period from 07th to 17th April 2021, the physical
functioning of all subordinate Courts/Tribunals of five
major districts viz. Ahmedabad, Vadodara, Surat, Rajkot
and Jamnagar, shall be suspended and judicial working
shall be carried out through online mode only, with
minimum Court staff.
2. All the above Courts may take up other matters e.g.
fixed for recording of evidence, hearing of arguments
etc. via virtual platform.
3. The above Courts may take up the matters physically
which are either brought or scheduled for compromise/
compounding.
4. The Judicial Officers may not pass any adverse order
owing to the absence of the advocates, parties,
witnesses or accused persons.
5. Only take away orders and parcel services are allowed
in the Canteens, if any, located within the Court
premises.
# 2 #
6. All the safety/precautionary measures envisaged vide
earlier circulars shall apply mutatis mutandis.
7. In so far as other districts are concerned, physical
functioning may continue but with limited hours of
working i.e. two hours in the first session and two hours
in the second session, which may be decided by the
Principal District and Sessions Judge with 50% of the
staff everyday.
8. Further review will be made on 15th April 2021 for
deciding the future course of action.
By order of Hon’ble The Chief Justice
Sd/-
Registrar General
High Court of Gujarat
